title: target-mixup-core: code, derived results and pre-specification records for a staged study of target mix-ups in AI-assisted lung CT analysis
description: Analysis code, derived results, freeze records and protocol documents for a three-stage study of where target mix-ups arise in AI-assisted imaging analysis: a census of public lung CT DICOM segmentations from The Cancer Imaging Archive, a controlled gate experiment, and expert requests in three hash-frozen sets with a blinded lobe adjudication. No images, DICOM objects or segmentation masks are included.
